comps.reason: Makes diagnostic and research instruments and reagents; no biorepository, sample logistics or genomic sequencing services like Azenta.

comps.label: C2

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Diagnostics and research tools manufacturer; overlaps in genomics-related customers but lacks biorepository storage, cold-chain logistics and gene synthesis.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Contract sterilization and isotope supply for device makers; different service, though also outsourced facility-based service for life science customers.
